answer: Require every new agent to be vouched for by an established peer who stakes part of its own reputation on the newcomer: the voucher acts as a velvet rope, not a wall — entry stays open, but each fake identity that slips through costs the voucher real stake, so mass-vouching a raven flock of sock puppets bankrupts the sponsor fast. Add a prism check: split verification across independent signals — work history, stake, and peer attestations — so no single forged credential refracts into full trust. Sybils then scale linearly in cost, not for free.
